source.name: MissionMed curated IMG supplement
source.selection: Identity-only records for medical schools that MissionMed students commonly attend and that the Wikidata 'medical school' class query does not return (universities whose medicine faculty has no separate Wikidata item), plus alias/city overrides for existing Wikidata identities.
source.license: MissionMed internal reference data; identity facts only

Ovidius University: Ovidius University of Constanța Faculty of Medicine
UNAM Faculty of Medicine: Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México Facultad de Medicina
Ignacio A. Santos School of Medicine: Tecnológico de Monterrey School of Medicine

limitations: Curated identities are not Wikidata-backed; each was added because a real student query returned no result.
A match establishes only an identity; it never verifies accreditation, active status, eligibility, or degree authority.
Overrides only add aliases or correct a city on an existing Wikidata identity; they never change its canonical id.
